skills.name: pi-cli-runtime
skills.description: Runtime specification for invoking the bundled pi-runner.mjs CLI that drives the local Pi coding agent. Reference this contract when routing task, review, setup, or job commands.

skills.name: pi-delegate
skills.description: Delegate a bounded coding, debugging, or research task to the local Pi coding agent CLI and return its result verbatim.

skills.name: pi-jobs
skills.description: Inspect, collect results from, tail logs for, or cancel Pi runs recorded by pi-runner.mjs.

skills.name: pi-review
skills.description: Run a read-only code review or adversarial design review with the local Pi coding agent for uncommitted changes or a branch diff.

skills.name: pi-setup
skills.description: Check whether the local Pi coding agent CLI is installed, configured with a model, and authenticated, and report the setup diagnostics verbatim.

skills.name: pi
skills.description: Delegate coding, debugging, code review, or research tasks to the local Pi coding agent CLI from Antigravity. Activate when the user asks to use Pi, review with Pi, get a second opinion from Pi, or delegate work to Pi.

agents.name: pi-rescue
agents.description: Delegate substantial debugging, diagnosis, or implementation tasks to the local Pi coding agent CLI. Use proactively when a second implementation pass, deeper root-cause investigation, or independent coding execution via Pi is needed.

readmeMarkdown:
Pi Plugin for Antigravity

Delegate coding, code review, and root-cause investigation from Google Antigravity to your local Pi coding agent CLI with zero external dependencies and least-privilege tool allowlists.

English | 简体中文

## Overview `pi-plugin-antigravity` connects **Google Antigravity** (the `agy` CLI, Antigravity 2.0 app, or Antigravity IDE) to your local **Pi coding agent** (`pi` CLI). You can trigger read-only code reviews, adversarial design reviews, or scoped coding tasks from natural language or slash commands without leaving your active workspace. The plugin bundles: - **Skills** (`pi`, `pi-setup`, `pi-review`, `pi-delegate`, `pi-jobs`, `pi-cli-runtime`) loaded on demand through Antigravity progressive disclosure. - **A forwarding subagent** (`pi-rescue`) for delegating substantial debugging or implementation tasks via `invoke_subagent`. - **A zero-dependency Node.js runner** (`scripts/pi-runner.mjs`) that invokes `pi --mode json`, streams progress, enforces tool allowlists, and records session history. This is an independent community project inspired by [`openai/codex-plugin-cc`](https://github.com/openai/codex-plugin-cc) and [`vacuityv/codex-plugin-antigravity`](https://github.com/vacuityv/codex-plugin-antigravity). It is not affiliated with Google or the Pi maintainers. ## Architecture No MCP server or private transport is required. `pi-runner.mjs` invokes your local `pi` binary directly over `--mode json` and can also be used standalone from any terminal or CI workflow. ```mermaid flowchart LR A["Antigravity Agent"] -->|"skill: pi / subagent: pi-rescue"| B["pi-runner.mjs"] B -->|"spawn"| C["pi --mode json"] C -->|"NDJSON events"| B B -->|"progress (stderr)"| A B -->|"final text (stdout)"| A ``` ## Requirements - **Pi coding agent** `1.7.0` or newer (requires `--mode json`) - **Configured provider credentials**: run `pi` once and sign in with `/login`, or run `pi auth login ` - **Node.js** `22.0.0` or newer (active/maintenance LTS: 22, 24, 26) - **Google Antigravity**: `agy` CLI, Antigravity 2.0 app, or Antigravity IDE - **Git**: required for `review` and `adversarial-review` ## Installation This package is distributed directly through **GitHub** (no npmjs account or GitHub Packages token required). ### Option 1: One-command install via `npx` (recommended) ```bash # Latest default branch npx github:hhelibeb/pi-plugin-antigravity # Pin a specific release tag or SemVer range npx github:hhelibeb/pi-plugin-antigravity#v0.1.0 npx "github:hhelibeb/pi-plugin-antigravity#semver:^0.1.0" ``` The installer automatically uses `agy plugin install` when the `agy` CLI is available, and falls back to copying a clean plugin bundle into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/pi`. Useful flags: ```bash # Install into the current workspace only (.agents/plugins/pi) npx github:hhelibeb/pi-plugin-antigravity --workspace # Skip `agy` CLI and copy directly to ~/.gemini/config/plugins/pi npx github:hhelibeb/pi-plugin-antigravity --copy # Uninstall (add --workspace to remove from the current workspace) npx github:hhelibeb/pi-plugin-antigravity uninstall ``` You can also install globally with `npm` (or directly from a GitHub Release `.tgz` tarball without requiring Git): ```bash # Install via GitHub shorthand (exposes both `pi-plugin-antigravity` and `pi-runner`) npm install -g github:hhelibeb/pi-plugin-antigravity#v0.1.0 pi-plugin-antigravity # Or install directly from a GitHub Release tarball (no Git required) npm install -g https://github.com/hhelibeb/pi-plugin-antigravity/releases/download/v0.1.0/pi-plugin-antigravity-0.1.0.tgz pi-plugin-antigravity ``` ### Option 2: `agy` CLI from a local clone ```bash git clone https://github.com/hhelibeb/pi-plugin-antigravity.git agy plugin install ./pi-plugin-antigravity agy plugin list ``` `agy plugin list` should show `pi` with 6 skills and 1 agent (`pi-rescue`). Update later by running `git pull` followed by `agy plugin install ./pi-plugin-antigravity`, or remove with `agy plugin uninstall pi`. ### Option 3: Manual copy (global or single workspace) ```bash # Global Antigravity plugins directory cp -r pi-plugin-antigravity ~/.gemini/config/plugins/pi # Or a single workspace mkdir -p path/to/project/.agents/plugins cp -r pi-plugin-antigravity path/to/project/.agents/plugins/pi ``` Restart Antigravity and run `/skills` to verify that `pi`, `pi-setup`, `pi-review`, `pi-delegate`, `pi-jobs`, and `pi-cli-runtime` are discovered. ## Quick start In Antigravity, ask **"Is Pi set up?"** (or run `/pi-setup`). This runs: ```bash node ~/.gemini/config/plugins/pi/scripts/pi-runner.mjs setup ``` On Windows PowerShell: ```powershell node "$env:USERPROFILE\.gemini\config\plugins\pi\scripts\pi-runner.mjs" setup ``` `setup` reports the Pi CLI version, binary resolution method, default model and auth status, Git repository availability, and local job storage path. ## Usage | Natural language prompt | Underlying command | | --- | --- | | "Is Pi set up?" | `pi-runner.mjs setup` | | "Review my uncommitted changes with Pi" | `review` (read-only) | | "Review this branch against main with Pi" | `review --base main` (read-only) | | "Run an adversarial design review with Pi" | `adversarial-review ""` (read-only) | | "Ask Pi to investigate this issue" | `task ""` (read-only) | | "Ask Pi to apply the fix" | `task "" --write` | | "Ask Pi to fix the bug and run the tests" | `task "" --shell` | | "Continue the last Pi session" | `task "" --resume-last` | | "Check Pi run status / result / stop it" | `status` / `result` / `cancel` | In the `agy` CLI, companion skills are also directly invocable as slash commands: `/pi-setup`, `/pi-review`, `/pi-delegate`, and `/pi-jobs`. ## Permission model Because Pi does not include an OS-level sandbox, the runner enforces least-privilege boundaries through Pi's `--tools` allowlist: | Command / preset | Allowed Pi tools | | --- | --- | | `review`, `adversarial-review` | `read,grep,find,ls` (locked; `--write`, `--shell`, and `--tools` are ignored with a warning) | | `task` (default) | `read,grep,find,ls` | | `task --write` | `read,grep,find,ls,edit,write` (no shell execution) | | `task --shell` | `read,grep,find,ls,edit,write,bash,powershell` | | `task --tools a,b,c` | Exact custom allowlist, replacing the preset | Key safeguards: - `--shell` executes commands with your local OS user privileges. Only enable it when command execution (tests, builds, git operations) is intended. - Non-interactive runs pass `--approve` so project trust prompts do not hang; pass `--no-project-trust` to send `--no-approve` for untrusted repositories. - Unknown flags (long or short) and value flags missing a value exit with code `2` before spawning `pi`, preventing typos such as `--writ` from silently changing run behavior. - Review prompts wrap diffs and untracked files in dynamically sized Markdown backtick fences and mark repository contents as untrusted data. See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for the full threat model and vulnerability reporting policy. ## Execution and job management - **Recommended inside Antigravity (foreground)**: Run `pi-runner.mjs` in the foreground and let Antigravity's `run_command` manage asynchronous execution and completion notifications. Progress lines stream to `stderr` per tool call so long runs remain visible. - **Standalone terminals (`--background`)**: When invoking `pi-runner.mjs` from a standalone shell, `--background` detaches a worker process and returns a job ID immediately. Note that on Windows or inside managed tool shells (such as Antigravity `run_command`), closing the parent shell can terminate detached child processes via process-tree cleanup; use foreground mode there instead. - **Session continuity (`--resume-last`)**: Both foreground and background runs record their Pi `sessionId` in `${PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR:-~/.pi/agent}/antigravity-plugin/jobs//meta.json`, allowing `--resume-last` to continue the newest completed session in the same directory. Stored job layout: ```text meta.json status, mode, phase, prompt summary, pid, childPid, sessionId, usage, exitCode argv.json exact pi argv for background runs (kept separate from meta.json) pi.log raw NDJSON event stream (background runs) output.txt final assistant output ``` Use `status [--all]`, `result [job-id]`, `log [job-id] --tail 40`, `cancel [job-id]`, and `prune [--days 14]` to inspect and maintain stored runs. ## Large prompts OS command-line limits (32,767 characters on Windows; 128 KiB per arg on POSIX) can cause `ENAMETOOLONG` errors when inlining large diffs. When a prompt exceeds the byte budget (`24,000` bytes on Windows, `100,000` bytes on POSIX, configurable via `PI_SUBAGENT_MAX_ARG_BYTES`): 1. The runner writes the full prompt to `${PI_SUBAGENT_PROMPTS:-/pi-antigravity-prompts}/`. 2. It passes a short pointer instructing Pi to read the file with its `read` tool. 3. If a custom `--tools` list omits `read`, the runner automatically adds `read` with a warning. 4. `prune` cleans up expired prompt files alongside finished jobs. ## Configuration | Environment variable | Description | | --- | --- | | `PI_BIN` | Explicit path to the `pi` binary when not on `PATH` | | `PI_SUBAGENT_MODEL` | Explicit default model override for delegated runs | | `PI_SUBAGENT_JOBS` | Custom directory for stored run metadata and logs | | `PI_SUBAGENT_PROMPTS` | Custom directory for materialized oversized prompt files | | `PI_SUBAGENT_MAX_ARG_BYTES` | Byte budget threshold for prompt materialization | | `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` | Pi configuration directory (default: `~/.pi/agent`) | | `PI_SUBAGENT_RUNNER` | Explicit path to `pi-runner.mjs` (read by skills and `pi-rescue`) | ## Troubleshooting - **`Pi CLI: not found`**: Verify `pi` is on `PATH`, or set `PI_BIN=/full/path/to/pi`. - **`Auth: unconfigured`**: Pi has no default model configured. Run `pi` and choose one with `/model`, or set `PI_SUBAGENT_MODEL=/`. - **Exit code `2` (`unknown option` / `missing value`)**: Run `node scripts/pi-runner.mjs --help` to check valid flags. Both `--flag value` and `--flag=value` are supported. - **Background job failed with no log on Windows**: The parent tool shell terminated the detached worker on exit. Re-run without `--background` so Antigravity manages the run asynchronously. - **Inspecting a failed background job**: Run `node scripts/pi-runner.mjs log --tail 40` or `node scripts/pi-runner.mjs result ` to view captured events or stderr. ## Project structure ```text plugin.json Antigravity plugin manifest assets/logo.svg Plugin icon agents/ pi-rescue.md Forwarding subagent for invoke_subagent skills/ pi/SKILL.md Main entry skill and command routing pi-cli-runtime/SKILL.md CLI runtime contract pi-setup/SKILL.md /pi-setup pi-review/SKILL.md /pi-review pi-delegate/SKILL.md /pi-delegate pi-jobs/SKILL.md /pi-jobs scripts/ install-plugin.mjs Standalone `npx` / `npm` installer and uninstaller for Antigravity pi-runner.mjs CLI entry point validate-plugin.mjs Offline manifest, skill/agent, and syntax validator lib/proc.mjs Binary resolution, argv building, NDJSON parsing, process control lib/git.mjs Git diff scoping, untracked file reading, review prompt builder lib/jobs.mjs Atomic on-disk job store and reconciliation lib/prompt.mjs Oversized prompt materialization and cleanup lib/output.mjs Duration, usage, and table formatters test/ Unit and end-to-end CLI tests (node:test with a stub Pi binary) ``` ## Development ```bash npm run check # Offline manifest, skill/agent frontmatter, and JS syntax check npm test # Run unit and CLI end-to-end tests (node --test) agy plugin validate --strict . # Official Antigravity plugin validator node scripts/pi-runner.mjs setup ``` See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md), [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md), and [LICENSE](LICENSE). ## Limitations - **Skills instead of `commands/`**: Antigravity plugins load skills, agents, rules, hooks, and MCP servers rather than a separate `commands/` directory, so every user entry point is packaged as a skill. - **Model resolution**: The runner only passes `--model` when `--model` or `PI_SUBAGENT_MODEL` is set; otherwise Pi resolves its own default model and provider credentials from `settings.json`. - **Windows binary shims**: Node cannot directly spawn `.cmd`/`.ps1` shims safely without shell parsing, so the runner resolves the underlying Node.js entry point (managed install or npm global shim) and falls back to hardened escaping if needed. - **Review diff budgets**: Untracked files are embedded up to 20 files / 60 KB total (skipping symlinks and binaries). Diffs truncate on UTF-8 character boundaries at 200 KB; Pi can inspect any remaining files directly with its read-only tools.
latestReleaseNotes:
## Install

### One-command Antigravity plugin install (via `npx` + GitHub)

```bash
npx github:hhelibeb/pi-plugin-antigravity#v0.1.0
```

Install into the current workspace only (`.agents/plugins/pi`):

```bash
npx github:hhelibeb/pi-plugin-antigravity#v0.1.0 --workspace
```

### Direct `npm` tarball install (no Git required)

```bash
npm install -g https://github.com/hhelibeb/pi-plugin-antigravity/releases/download/v0.1.0/pi-plugin-antigravity-0.1.0.tgz
pi-plugin-antigravity
```
